sample_unit: AI-generated patient education guides (4 diseases x 2 chatbots)

links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated patient education materials versus recommended patient-material level
links.effect: Both ChatGPT and DeepSeek produced patient education content above the recommended readability level for patient materials; readability scores were similar between tools.
links.quote: The readability scores indicated that both tools produced content that was above the recommended level for patient materials.
